items.titel: Item · Serial number that doesn't match the logbook
items.soll: a small brushed steel engine plate with an engraved serial number lying on an open ship's logbook with neat handwritten columns, one entry circled in red pencil

items.titel: Item · Power log: load on the bridge at 02:10
items.soll: a long curled paper printout strip from a ship's power monitor showing a calm line graph with one sharp tall spike, a red pencil mark next to the spike

items.titel: Item · GPS track with a detour towards the Esterel
items.soll: a rugged marine tablet showing a nautical chart of a rocky coastline with a glowing blue route line that suddenly bends away in a wide loop towards red cliffs
a black smartphone lying face up, its glowing screen showing an incoming call over a photo of the Eiffel Tower at night
a single ship's electrical circuit breaker with a short strip of beige masking tape on it, marked with quick pen strokes

items.titel: Item · Charred charging cable from the VIP cabin
items.soll: a white phone charging cable, partly charred and melted near the plug, the plug blackened, coiled loosely
a small silver pendant shaped like an open human hand with five fingers, palm facing the viewer, smooth polished silver, hanging from a simple black cord
a French Foreign Legion kepi seen from the side: tall cylindrical cap covered in bright white fabric, a black leather visor and a slightly frayed band, standing upright
a faded red woollen scarf, a little damp, loosely folded, a few dry pine needles caught in it
a black military field radio with a short rubber antenna, a smooth matte casing and a small plain white logo plate on the front
a grey handheld remote control with a small dark infrared lamp at the top and one large round dial, smooth plastic casing
an old folding shepherd's knife with a smooth polished horn handle and a half open steel blade

items.titel: Item · The Part That Isn't Ours
items.soll: a small black electronic module with a smooth casing, a tiny plain white logo and a short flat ribbon cable
a child's crayon drawing on white paper of a smiling man with a big moustache in a little red boat on blue waves under a yellow sun
a heavy grey plastic transport crate with its lid closed and latched, a small plain white logo and a stencilled code on the side
a small round tin saint's medal on a short chewed green string

items.titel: Item · A Ring in a Velvet Box
items.soll: a delicate silver ring with one tiny blue stone sitting in an open small dark blue velvet box
a clear waterproof document folder holding old photographs of a wooden schooner and a nautical map of a bay with one red circle drawn on it
a single page torn from an old nautical chart book, soft pencil lines of a bay, one small pencil cross and a faded date in the margin
